details.releaseNotesExcerpt: <details open> server: save only restorable slot states to the prompt cache (#30498) * server: save only restorable slot states to the prompt cache The idle-slot save loop stores every idle slot whenever a task starts, while only completion tasks restore from the prompt cache. Rerank, embedding, decision and infill states fill the cache up to its limit without ever being read back, and slots already cached are offered again at every task start. Each slot now tracks with cache_pending whether its state is restorable and missing from the cache: a completion release or an explicit slot restore sets it, prompt_save consumes it, prompt_clear resets it. details.releaseNotesExcerpt: ## Overview llama.cpp v0.7.0 adds the LiliCorr speculative decoding technique and MTP for GLM5-Next, a new GPU cache for MoE experts kept in host memory (`--moe-cache-mib`, up to ~2.2x decode speedup when experts are offloaded), and a large batch of new models: K2 Horizon (dense and MoVA), Prism Bonsai 2 27B, EmbeddingGemma-2 (text+vision+audio), the LiquidAI d1/d1-omni and vLLM decision 2/d3 decision models, pplx-decider, MiniCPM-V 4.7, Nemotron Super 3.5 VL / Nemotron Bolt and maion-coder. details.releaseNotesExcerpt: <details open> model: add Muse Spark Open (text, vision and audio) (#30616) * model: add Muse Spark Open (text, vision and audio) Muse Spark Open is a latent space MoE: the residual stream stays at 8192 while the 256 experts live in 4096, with a projection down and up around them, top-8 sigmoid routing with a correction bias. Attention interleaves three sliding layers at a 2048 window with rope for one global layer without rope, with a sigmoid output gate and a weightless QK-norm. Residuals are norm preserving, their gate is folded at conversion time. Vision reuses the Muse Glimmer tower. Audio is a causal convolutional pyramid with no attention and no spectrogram, four stages folding 16, 6, 5 and 4 samples into the channel dim, one embedding per 80 ms of 24 kHz. The quantizer keeps the latent projections and the attention gate at Q8_0, a little over 1% of the weights, since the whole residual stream passes through them and the low-bit types turned the output into a repeating loop.
